0|5aae9265ee1a30cf716d6caf6b29fe99b9d55130|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"mm: prep_compound_tail() clear page->private
Although page allocation always clears page->private in the first page or
head page of an allocation
column2: it has never made a point of clearing

column1: page->private in the tails (though 0 is often what is already there).
But now commit 71e2d666ef85 (""mm/huge_memory: do not clobber swp_entry_t
during THP split"") issues a warning when page_tail->private is found to be
non-0 (unless it's swapcache).
Change that warning to dump page_tail (which also dumps head)
just the head: so far we have seen dead000000000122
dead000000000001 or 0000000000000002 in the raw output for tail private.
We could just delete the warning
column2: but today's consensus appears to want

column1: page->private to be 0
column2: unless there's a good reason for it to be set: so

column1: now clear it in prep_compound_tail() (more general than just for THP; but
not for high order allocation
column2: which makes no pass down the tails).
